# <span id="aanchor15"></span> Master Allocation Setup

Use the Master Allocation Setup screen to configure the associations between a master and its member wells (meters) that will be used in the allocation process.

Master Allocation requires **Master Allocation** and **Meter** or **Location Edit** system process privileges.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 564;height: 443;" />

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Master Allocation Setup screen:

- **Gas, Liquid** – The fluid phase for the master allocation meter (gas) or location (liquid).
- **System and Meter/Location** – Master meter or location.
- **From/To** – Applicable date and time range.
- **Delete** – Delete an association for the specified time frame.
- **Direction** – Direction of master meter (gas). Master locations will use the direction that has been defined for the location within the [Location Editor](../../Locations/Location%20Editor/Location%20Editor.md).
- **Energy Alloc Method** – The method of allocation for the selected meter or location. Available options are:
  - **Allocated** – Allocate the energy directly from the master to its members.
  - **Calculated** – Recalculate the energy after a master volume has been allocated to its members.

The Direction and Energy Alloc Method options are only available for gas master allocations.

##### Grid Details

- **Number** – Meter number.
- **Name** – Meter name.
- **Direction** – Meter direction.
- **KW (Keep Whole)** – Indicates whether a meter member will be <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCTextPopup MCTextPopupHotSpot MCTextPopup_Open glossaryTerm MCTextPopupHotSpot_" alt="Closed" data-mc-alt2="Open">kept whole<span class="MCTextPopupBody popupBody"><span class="MCTextPopupArrow"></span>Volume, energy, and mass for meters that are "kept whole" in the allocation process will not be adjusted to compensate for a surplus or deficit.</span></a> during the allocation process.

Outlet meters are highlighted in blue; inlet meters are highlighted in red.

##### Button Details

- **Refresh** – Refresh the screen.
- **Delete** – Delete the master meter or location and its relationships for all of time.
- **Edit** – Edit an existing master allocation meter or location.
- **New** – Create a new master allocation meter or location.
- **Exit** – Exit the screen.

</div>
